title: 第59章 恩威并施，方少的投名状

第59章 恩威并施，方少的投名状-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

饭局的后半程，包间里安静得出奇。

大伯母再也没提过半个关于“相亲”和“建军”的字眼，

甚至连说话的音量都自觉降了八度，生怕惊动了什么。

大伯闷头扒饭，偶尔举起酒杯敬林川。

杯沿压得比桌面还低，碰杯时只敢沾个边。

沈母在经历了最初的震撼后，慢慢回过神。她没怎么动筷子，只是盯着林川看。

眼神里那股丈母娘审视女婿的挑剔早没了，剩下的只有拘谨和敬畏。

吃过饭，众人下楼。

大堂经理一路小跑着跟在旁边，弯着腰汇报，说方少已经把单买了，门外备了两辆车，随时听候调遣。

林川没要方锐的车跟随，自己开了那辆宝马7系，带着沈蔓和一家人回县城。

来时的车厢里压抑得让人发虚，回去的路上，后排却显得格外热闹。

大伯母的身子拼命往前探，两只手死死扒着前排的座椅靠背，恨不得把头塞到正副驾驶中间。

“小林啊，刚才那阵仗真是吓死个人了。”大伯母的声音甜得发腻，

“那个方少，听说在成都是个手眼通天的人物呢！我看他对你客气得像个小弟，你这生意在上海，肯定是做得大得没边了吧？”

林川单手扶着方向盘，看着前方的夜路，语气平淡。

“朋友给面子，算不上通天。”

“哎呀，你就是太谦虚了！”大伯母笑得满脸堆褶，眼珠子骨碌碌转了两圈，终于图穷匕见，

“小林啊，你看你生意做得这么大，蔓蔓跟着你算是掉进福窝里了。大伯母想着……你堂弟小峰，今年大专刚毕业，在县城里高不成低不就的。”

她顿了顿，语气越发热络。

“你看能不能让他去你上海的公司，跟在你后头见见世面？哪怕跑跑腿、端端茶也行啊！都是自家人，用着也放心不是？”

坐在副驾的沈蔓脸色瞬间沉了下来。

她刚想开口把话堵回去，林川却抢先出声了。

“大伯母。”

林川的声调没变，但车厢里的温度明显降了几分。

“投资不是开小卖部。”林川看着路况，连头都没回，

“我手底下的人，起步是复旦、交大的硕士。他们经手的，都是几千万上亿的盘子。小峰过去，连个实习生的活他都接不住，每天的压力会直接把他压垮。”

大伯母脸上的笑僵住了。

“这……跑个腿总行吧？不需要什么学历吧？”

“公司有专门的行政团队，不养闲人。”林川从后视镜里扫了她一眼，

“真想锻炼，成都机会很多。上海的圈子，水太深，他不适合。”

这几句话说得滴水不漏，却像一堵铁墙，直接把大伯母想顺杆爬、吸血的念头堵了个严严实实。

大伯在旁边扯了扯大伯母的袖子，用力瞪了她一眼。大伯母干笑了两声，讪讪地缩回座位，彻底闭了嘴。

坐在另一侧的沈母看着这一幕，心里最后一块石头也落了地。

她一直担心女儿找个有钱人会受欺负，但今晚她看明白了。

这个年轻人的手腕和城府，根本不是普通人能想象的。

During the second half of the meal, the private room was eerily quiet.

My eldest aunt never mentioned a word about "blind date" or "building an army" again.

Even the volume of his speech was consciously lowered by an octave, for fear of disturbing something.

The uncle was busy cooking rice, and occasionally raised his glass of wine to pay homage to Lin Chuan.

The rim of the glass is pressed lower than the tabletop, so you only dare to touch the edge when you clink the glasses.

After experiencing the initial shock, Mother Shen slowly recovered.She didn't move her chopsticks much, just stared at Lin Chuan.

The critical look of a mother-in-law scrutinizing her son-in-law has long since disappeared, leaving only restraint and awe.

After dinner, everyone went downstairs.

The lobby manager trotted next to him and bent down to report, saying that Mr. Fang had already purchased the order and had two cars ready outside the door, ready to be dispatched at any time.

Lin Chuan did not ask Fang Rui's car to follow him. He drove the BMW 7 Series himself and took Shen Man and his family back to the county town.

The car was so depressing when we arrived, but on the way back, the back row seemed particularly lively.

The eldest aunt leaned forward desperately, holding on to the back of the front seat with both hands, wanting to put her head between the driver and passenger.

"Xiao Lin, that battle just now was really scary to death." The eldest aunt's voice was so sweet that she said,

"That Mr. Fang, I heard that he is a man with great hands and eyes in Chengdu! I think he is as polite to you as a little brother. Your business in Shanghai must be very big, right?"

Lin Chuan held the steering wheel with one hand and looked at the night road ahead with a calm tone.

"Friends giving face is not worth mentioning."

"Oh, you are so humble!" The eldest aunt smiled with her face full of folds, her eyes rolled around twice, and finally she saw,

"Xiao Lin, you see your business is so big, Manman has fallen into a lucky nest by following you. Auntie is thinking... your cousin Xiaofeng just graduated from junior college this year, and he is not good at high or low in the county."

She paused and her tone became more enthusiastic.

"Do you think you can let him go to your company in Shanghai and follow you to see the world? Even running errands and serving tea is fine! They are all family members, so you can rest assured to use him, right?"

Shen Man, who was sitting in the passenger seat, suddenly darkened.

She was about to speak to stop her words, but Lin Chuan spoke up first.

"Auntie."

Lin Chuan's tone did not change, but the temperature in the carriage dropped significantly.

"Investment is not about opening a canteen." Lin Chuan looked at the traffic without even looking back.

"The people under me started with master's degrees from Fudan University and Jiaotong University. They handled projects worth tens of millions or hundreds of millions. In Xiaofeng's past, he couldn't even handle the job of an intern. The daily pressure would directly crush him."

The smile on the aunt's face froze.

"Is this... just an errand? Doesn't it require any academic qualifications?"

"The company has a dedicated administrative team and does not support idle people." Lin Chuan glanced at her in the rearview mirror.

"I really want to exercise. There are many opportunities in Chengdu. The circle in Shanghai is too deep and he is not suitable."

These few words were said without leakage, but they were like an iron wall, blocking the aunt's thoughts of crawling along the pole and sucking blood.

The uncle tugged on the aunt's sleeves and gave her a hard look.The eldest aunt laughed twice, shrank back to her seat, and shut her mouth completely.

Sitting on the other side, Mother Shen watched this scene, and the last stone fell in her heart.

She had always been worried that her daughter would be bullied if she found a rich man, but tonight she saw it clearly.

This young man's skills and abilities are beyond the imagination of ordinary people.
